method.source: sparse zero-filled file with a distinct deterministic SHA-256 marker in every 4 MiB chunk
method.publish: saveLargeCystFile to LargeCystPrivateStore at the exact 2 GiB package quota
method.restart: close and reopen private store, compare committed manifest
method.restore: restoreLargeCystFile to a separate private destination
method.verification: compare every source and restored byte in 4 MiB chunks and independently compute both whole-file SHA-256 digests

limits: No HTTP transfer, S3 provider, independent region, or chain transaction was used.
The source is sparse but every byte was read, encrypted, stored, decrypted, restored, and compared.
The 20-second performance target was not met: local publish alone took 63 seconds.
The driver-reported RSS is not a production memory bound; an unattributed concurrent OS snapshot showed a Node process with a larger working set.
